name: Nepal 26 August 2026 Flood Disaster
model: one national incident with event zones, immutable source records, identity relationships, reviewed person clusters and append-only status events
rules: source record is not automatically a unique person
removal from a list is not proof of resolution
death is never inferred from age, sex or geography alone
unidentified-body records remain separate until hard evidence supports identity
all consequential identity/status conclusions require provenance and human review
